data.wealth_measure: NETWORTHR, the PSID-SHELF family net-worth measure; INCFAMR, total family income
data.wealth_level_estimand: weighted Q90(NETWORTHR) / weighted Q50(NETWORTHR), same observations and weights

bootstrap.population_definition: All living positive-weight PSID reference persons ages 65-84 in waves 2003/05, before age-76-84 outcome and children-history filters; this exactly follows the existing builder and is not a 416-person final-sample-only bootstrap.

nonasset_income_denominator.reason: The selected shelf contract provides family income and reference-person earnings, but not a defensible household non-asset-income decomposition.

model.reason: B checkpoint is named under /scratch and was not read. Frozen source plus saved B moments suffice because the annual denominator is constant over all selected observations.
model.observer_wealth: b + pH for owners; b for renters
model.wealth_timing: beginning-of-period asset distribution; no transaction wedge subtracted
model.annual_income: Same positive constant in all selected age/location/z/tenure cells: period pension / 4; no payroll gross-up at retirement. Frozen defaults set retirement_income_z_scale=0; B records property_tax_lump_sum_transfer=0; estate transfers are confined to ages 45-65.
model.source_check: Pinned 2026-09-22 B contract matches code at commit 70abd4a80df979903b05d361f47ac2bf5aab2c23: parameter-builder SHA256 c0c1c18500fba069152659eaf588c3c895993cdcecb104cee7d6edca6bfae6a5 and observer SHA256 169bf4c108af35f1c2f76d74da568a0aedc256ca32395a5b5477eb153a8a2e59 match the frozen contract. The only later code correction is solver-only tenure-probability mass conservation (contract scope); it leaves income construction untouched. Frozen parameter defaults: J_R=12, period_years=4, retirement_income_z_scale=0; pension builder assigns P.income[i,j]=P.pension for all locations and j>=J_R; annual-income observer calls annual_gross_income_at_state; estate transfers only ages 45-65. B summary records pension 2.046361389612122 and property-tax transfer 0.

interpretation: The exact old-age dispersion target is reproducible. In this window, observed-children selection has no empirical effect. B's ratio moment equals its wealth-level p90/p50 exactly because income is constant across selected observations. The model level ratio is 2.055 empirical SE below the PSID level ratio while its family-income-ratio target gap is 0.690 SE; this difference does not isolate a causal denominator effect from the remaining sample, coverage, and asset-definition mappings. Model wealth quantile levels are model units, not dollar-calibrated.
